```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(Seurat)

# Load your Seurat object (adjust the path as needed)
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/SAVE/asdf.save.rds")

# Extract barcodes for malignant and normal T cells
# Adjust the strings ("malignant_T" / "normal_T") to match your cell type annotations
malignant_barcodes <- rownames(asdf@meta.data)[asdf@meta.data$new.clones == "Malignant"]
normal_barcodes <- rownames(asdf@meta.data)[asdf@meta.data$new.clones == "Non_malignant"]

# Save barcode lists to text files (one barcode per line)
write.table(malignant_barcodes, file = "malignant_barcodes.txt", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(normal_barcodes, file = "normal_barcodes.txt", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat("Extracted", length(malignant_barcodes), "malignant barcodes and",
    length(normal_barcodes), "normal barcodes.\n")

```







```{bash}
# For malignant cells:
python3 filter_fastq_by_barcode.py --r1 R1.fastq.gz --r2 R2.fastq.gz \
    --barcodes malignant_barcodes.txt --out_r1 malignant_R1.fastq --out_r2 malignant_R2.fastq

# For normal cells:
python3 filter_fastq_by_barcode.py --r1 R1.fastq.gz --r2 R2.fastq.gz \
    --barcodes normal_barcodes.txt --out_r1 normal_R1.fastq --out_r2 normal_R2.fastq

```






```{bash}
# For malignant cells:
STAR --runThreadN 8 \
     --genomeDir /path/to/STAR_genome/ \
     --readFilesIn malignant_R1.fastq malignant_R2.fastq \
     --outFileNamePrefix malignant_ \
     --outSAMtype SAM

# For normal cells:
STAR --runThreadN 8 \
     --genomeDir /path/to/STAR_genome/ \
     --readFilesIn normal_R1.fastq normal_R2.fastq \
     --outFileNamePrefix normal_ \
     --outSAMtype SAM

```




```{bash}
# For malignant cells:
samtools sort -@ 8 -o malignant_sorted.bam malignant_Aligned.out.sam
samtools index malignant_sorted.bam

# For normal cells:
samtools sort -@ 8 -o normal_sorted.bam normal_Aligned.out.sam
samtools index normal_sorted.bam

```





```{bash}
# For malignant cells:
bcftools mpileup -Ou -f /path/to/reference.fa malignant_sorted.bam | \
    bcftools call -mv -Ob -o malignant.bcf
bcftools view malignant.bcf > malignant_variants.vcf

# For normal cells:
bcftools mpileup -Ou -f /path/to/reference.fa normal_sorted.bam | \
    bcftools call -mv -Ob -o normal.bcf
bcftools view normal.bcf > normal_variants.vcf

```








```{bash}
# For malignant cells:
stringtie malignant_sorted.bam -G /path/to/annotation.gtf -o malignant_isoforms.gtf -p 8

# For normal cells:
stringtie normal_sorted.bam -G /path/to/annotation.gtf -o normal_isoforms.gtf -p 8

```
